arl_token.label: ARL token
arl_token.description: Your Deezer ARL cookie token. See https://www.dumpmedia.com/deezplus/deezer-arl.html

manifest.description: Stream Deezer’s full music catalogue in CD-quality (FLAC) audio.

errors.no_subscription: This Deezer account has no subscription that Music Assistant can stream from. Deezer Free accounts are not supported; check that the subscription on this specific account is still active.
errors.arl_rejected: Deezer did not accept the ARL token for this account. It is most likely expired or was copied from a different account -- grab a fresh one and try again.
errors.gw_no_session: Deezer accepted the ARL for this account but did not hand out a playback session. The token itself is fine, so a fresh one will not help -- try again, and restart Music Assistant if it keeps happening.
errors.auth_failed: Could not sign in to Deezer. See the Music Assistant log for the reason reported by Deezer.
